sources.title: USDA FoodData Central Download Datasets
sources.finding: The official Latest Downloads table lists April 2026 as the latest branded JSON and CSV bulk release at this check. April 2026 is the stated release month; the JSON download filename carries the snapshot date 2026-04-30.

sources.title: USDA Global Branded Food Products Database Documentation
findings: Data providers supply the labels; USDA standardizes presentation. Bulk files do not include monthly changes made between releases.
The source converts nutrients to a 100-unit basis in grams or milliliters, depending on the provider's supplied unit. Milliliters do not establish a gram mass.
An omitted nutrient is unknown. A reported zero may reflect label rounding. Neither missing data nor a not-significant-source statement authorizes filling zero.

Historical source updates can change descriptions, brands, nutrients, and ingredients. An update is not necessarily a reformulation. An update-log reference alone supplies no historical nutrient body.
Market attribution is retained exactly as supplied, with the United States and US spelling aliases mapped to US. New Zealand is separate. The source does not establish present retailer inventory.

sources.title: FoodData Central API Guide — Licensing
sources.finding: USDA identifies FoodData Central as public domain under CC0 1.0 Universal and requests source attribution. This partition remains independent from Open Food Facts and its ODbL obligations.

sources.title: FoodData Central Download Field Descriptions
sources.finding: Repeated GTIN/UPC codes identify source updates, distinguished chronologically by publication_date. Every actual source FDC ID is retained; same-market barcode grouping does not merge nutrient values.

sources.title: GS1 T0055 Unit of measure
sources.finding: The primary GS1 code table explicitly defines GRM as gram and MLT as millilitre. These are unit aliases, with no change to numerical amount or gram-to-volume inference. MG, IU, GM and MC are not normalized by this importer because their source meaning and nutrient denominator are not established by this evidence.

implementation.recordEncoding: Deterministic gzip JSON with 3-hex SHA-256 ID shards; uncompressed manifest.json.
implementation.idPolicy: branded:usda:<fdcId>. The importer refuses to finish if an established production ID would disappear.
implementation.datePolicy: Parse month/day/year and ISO source dates to ISO before comparison. Latest means greatest publication date within this source bulk snapshot.
implementation.versionPolicy: Same-market normalized GTINs form source-version groups. Distinct source IDs, ingredients, package wording, serving units and nutrient bodies remain preserved. Fingerprints include nutrient values so changed nutrition cannot be silently deduplicated.
implementation.historyPolicy: History entries contain source IDs and dates only, plus whether that actual record exists in the catalogue. Missing historical nutrient bodies are never fabricated.
implementation.coveragePolicy: No brand allowlist and no artificial row target. Accept each source-supported US/NZ food with product identity, at least one finite core nutrient and a positive, documented serving basis.
